gdpr.warning:
### **Zaroori Jankari**
* Deletion **permanent** hai aur undo nahi kiya ja sakta
* Aap sirf **apne** owned servers ke transcripts hi delete kar sakte hai
* Transcripts mein sirf **aapke** messages hi anonymize ho sakte hai
* Request complete hone mein **30 din** tak lag sakte hai
* Aapki request ek **queue** mei process ki jayegi

error.invalid_ticket_ids: Invalid ticket IDs enter kiye gaye hain. Please numeric ticket IDs commas se separate karke enter kare (jaise: 123, 456, 789).
error.not_owner: Transcripts delete karne ke liye aapka server owner hona zaroori hai.
error.queue_failed: GDPR request queue karne mein fail ho gaya. Please thodi der baad dobara try kare.
error.worker_offline: GDPR processing service abhi unavailable hai. Please thodi der baad dobara try kare ya agar issue bana rahe toh support se contact kare.

errors.unknown_channel:
Required channel nahi mil saka: shayad yeh delete ho chuka hai.

Please server administrator se kahe ki woh [dashboard](%s) par jakar verify kare ki sabhi channel settings theek se configured hain.
errors.unknown_member: User nahi mil saka. Ho sakta hai unhone server chhod diya ho ya unhe ban kar diya gaya ho.
errors.unknown_message:
Aap jis message ke saath interact karne ki koshish kar rahe hain woh delete ho chuka hai.

Please kisi doosre message ke saath dobara try kare.
errors.unknown_role:
Is action ke liye required role ab exist nahi karta.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) par jakar role settings ko reconfigure kare.
errors.unknown_category:
Required category nahi mil saki: shayad yeh delete ho chuki hai.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) par jakar is ticket panel ke liye ek valid channel category assign kare.
errors.unknown_interaction:
Yeh interaction expire ho chuka hai.

Please action ko dobara try kare.
errors.max_webhooks:
Server maximum webhooks ki limit tak pahunch gaya hai.

Please server administrator se kahe ki kuch unused webhooks remove kare aur dobara try kare.
errors.max_channels:
Aapka ticket open nahi ho saka kyunki yeh server Discord ki channel limit (500) tak pahunch gaya hai.

Please naya ticket open karne se pehle server administrator se kahe ki kuch tickets close kare ya unused channels delete kare.
errors.interaction_acknowledged:
Yeh interaction pehle hi process ho chuka hai.

Agar aapko yeh action dobara perform karna hai, toh please ek naya interaction start kare.

missing_permissions.title: Is action ko perform karne ke liye mere paas yeh permissions missing hain
missing_permissions.body:
Please bot ko yeh permissions assign kare, ya alternative ke roop mein `Administrator` permission dekar dobara try kare.

Har permission kyun zaroori hai iski jankari ke liye hamare [docs](%s) visit kare.

errors.missing_access:
Is action ko perform karne ke liye mere paas zaroori permissions missing hai.

Please bot ko zaroori permissions assign kare, ya alternative ke roop mein `Administrator` permission dekar dobara try kare.
Har permission kyun zaroori hai iski jankari ke liye hamare [docs](%s) visit kare.
errors.invalid_length:
Ek ya zyada fields bohot chhote ya bohot lambe hai.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) visit kare aur sabhi inputs verify karke ensure kare ki fields length constraints meet karte hai.
errors.required_field:
Ek required field missing ya khali hai.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) visit kare aur verify kare ki sabhi required fields bhare hue hai.
errors.invalid_channel_type:
Is operation ke liye channel type invalid hai.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) visit kare aur ticket panel ko ek valid channel assign kare.
errors.invalid_category:
Channel category invalid hai, shayad yeh delete ho chuki hai.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) visit kare aur ticket panel ko ek valid category assign kare.
errors.invalid_id:
Bot configuration mein ek invalid ID enter ki gayi thi.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh [dashboard](%s) visit kare aur verify kare ki sabhi category, channel aur role IDs sahi hain.
errors.invalid_characters:
Input mein invalid characters hain.

Please sirf letters, numbers, hyphens aur underscores use kare.
errors.invalid_choice:
Ek invalid option provide kiya gaya tha.

Please server administrator se kahein ki woh das[dashboard](%s) board visit kare aur verify kare ki sabhi settings sahi hai.
errors.invalid_form: Invalid input ki wajah se yeh action complete nahi ho saka.
errors.thread_locked:
Aapka ticket open nahi ho saka kyunki ticket thread locked hai.

Please server administrator se ticket thread unlock karne ko kahe.
errors.max_active_threads:
Aapka ticket open nahi ho saka kyunki is channel mein active threads ki maximum limit reach ho chuki hai.

Please server administrator se kuch tickets ya threads close karne ko kahe.
errors.timed_out: Operation time out ho gaya, please dobara try kare.
errors.rate_limited: Aap rate limit ho rahe hain. Please %s baad dobara try kare.
errors.rate_limited_global: Discord par heavy load hai (global rate limit). Please %s baad dobara try kare.
errors.general: Yeh action perform karte waqt ek error aa gaya.
